role: The server's keepalive ping, sent every 40 network ticks with a random-ish id; the client's reply measures latency.
scope_reason: Wire format and connection plumbing: native messages are structs by design (SPEC: messages are structs, not bytes) (triage 2026-09-25, out/plan/remaining-2026-09-25.md).

missing: The keepalive ping itself is unmodelled (it changes no game state). Its pacing counter is: NetHandlerPlayServer.networkTickCount is player.h's network_tick_count, seeded from the snapshot's "net" compound, and its % 20 branch re-sends the last position as an S08 while the player has not moved (player.c:1438).
notes: The % 20 S08 correction is a different vanilla mechanism from the 40-tick ping; both read the same counter, and only the S08 correction is observable in tapes.
